desc:
• BETTY AND REESE'S TOGETHER: Betty Crocker brings iconic REESE'S Peanut Butter chips to your kitchen; Turn coffee cake mix into part of a breakfast, brunch, or sweet snack this season

  • BROWN SUGAR STREUSEL: Enjoy a delicious and festive brown sugar streusel topping for your cake

  • QUICK AND EASY: Just mix, bake and sprinkle on streusel for an irresistible and indulgent treat to share; Make cake a part of food gift baskets or treats table

  • REESE'S PEANUT BUTTER CHIPS: The only coffee cake with mini REESE'S Peanut Butter chips in the mix, ready to delight guests at Thanksgiving, holiday parties, and any celebration

  • CONTAINS: One 14.2 oz box of Betty Crocker REESE'S Peanut Butter Coffee Cake Mix
features:
Features

Delicious blend: Combines soft peanut butter cookie dough with Reese’s Mini Pieces candy and mini chocolate chips for a sweet and crunchy texture.

Quick and easy prep: Just add butter and an egg—mix, scoop, and bake in under 20 minutes.

Fun and colorful: The Reese’s Pieces candy adds a burst of color and crunch, making the cookies visually appealing and fun to eat.

Trusted brand: Made by Betty Crocker, known for reliable, high-quality baking products.

Convenient size: Comes in an 11.9 oz pouch that makes about a dozen cookies—perfect for quick treats or small gatherings.

Benefits

Rich peanut butter flavor: Offers a classic, indulgent Reese’s taste experience in a warm, freshly baked cookie.

Family-friendly activity: Simple enough for kids to help with—great for baking together.

Perfect for any occasion: Ideal for bake sales, parties, school lunches, or satisfying sweet cravings.

No mess, no stress: Minimal ingredients required and easy cleanup afterward.

Reliable results: Consistently soft, chewy cookies with every batch—no guesswork needed.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Mini REESE'S Peanut Butter Chips (partially defatted peanuts, sugar, hydrogenated vegetable oil [palm kernel, soybean], corn syrup solids, dextrose, reduced protein whey, salt, palm kernel oil, artificial flavor, soy lecithin), Palm Oil, REESE'S Peanut Butter (peanuts, sugar, monoglycerides, peanut oil, salt, molasses, corn starch), Brown Sugar. Contains 2% or less of: Modified Corn Starch, Leavening (baking soda, monocalcium phosphate, sodium aluminum phosphate), Salt, Monoglycerides, Color Added, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum.
